description: Agent Childcare Records: submit childcare enrollment records as aggregate counts with the licensed capacity and age groups the facility record states: the facility with its reference, name, licensed capacity and the age groups its license covers; each enrollment total with its id, reference, the day counted and the count enrolled in all; each count by age group with its id, reference, the day counted, the age group and the count enrolled. The signed report gives the enrollment and the records behind it, the enrolled count on each day against the licensed capacity, each enrollment total against the age-group counts on its day, each age-group count against the age groups the license covers, and each count entry for its age group and count, and counts them, and names divergent childcare enrollment records: enrolled counts past the licensed capacity, a total the age-group counts on its day do not add up to, enrollment counted for an age group the license does not cover, and a count entry missing the age group or the count; then two counts for one age group on one day and a total with no age-group counts on its day, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No totals or counts, or no licensed capacity beside counts, leaves those points unverified. Entries match by letters and digits, age groups by their words with plurals folded, counts as whole numbers, days by the day, and a count equal to capacity is inside it. Counts only, with no entry for any one child: this reads the roster count against licensed capacity, while wever_childcare-ratio-record-check reads the daily staffing evidence. Verdict childcare_enrollment_record_divergent, childcare_enrollment_record_partial, childcare_enrollment_record_unverified or childcare_enrollment_record_consistent. POST /api/childcare-enrollment-record-check. Reads the childcare records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no childcare facility, contacts no licensing agency or parent, runs no background check on anyone and issues no license, credential or certification, which stay with the operator and the licensing agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Childcare Records reads licensed childcare facility and staff compliance records, for childcare centers and family childcare homes, and never a record about an individual child: health records belong to Agent Healthcare, education records belong to Agent Education, food-safety records belong to Agent Food Safety Records, staff checks read the licensing qualification file and never run background checks, and pet daycare is not childcare (Agent Veterinary Records reads animal records). It reads a childcare operator’s own compliance paper: the childcare facility record with its license and license conditions, the licensing agency’s childcare inspection record, the childcare staff record with training entries, each childcare credential as issued, the childcare enrollment record and the childcare ratio record as counts, the childcare incident record from its date, type, notification and filing fields, and the childcare safety record with the emergency plan, each against the inspection, enrollment, condition, schedule, violation, requirement, qualification, placement, reliance, capacity, staffing, notification, drill and corrective action records it answers to. The family’s ground is the childcare facility’s paper trail: what the facility record and its license claim, whether the inspections hold up, what the staff and credential records support, what the enrollment and ratio counts show, and whether the incident log and the safety record line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-childcare-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-childcare-records/.

age_groups.description: Age groups the facility license covers.

capacity.description: The count of children the license allows.

groups.description: Each enrollment count by age group, as an aggregate count.

enrolled.description: The count enrolled in the age group.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

totals.description: Each enrollment total the childcare enrollment record states, as an aggregate count.
